description: This file contains implementation of network socket utility functions for address resolution, socket configuration, and comparison, specific to the 'ocudu' namespace.

classes.name: sockaddr_storage_less
classes.description: Comparator class for sockaddr_storage objects based on family, port, address, and scope ID.

methods.name: getnameinfo
methods.description: Retrieves hostname and service info from a sockaddr structure.

methods.name: get_nameinfo
methods.description: Returns a socket_name_info object with IP address and port.

methods.name: set_reuse_addr
methods.description: Sets SO_REUSEADDR option on a socket.

methods.name: bind_to_interface
methods.description: Binds a socket to a specific network interface.

methods.name: sockaddr_to_ip_str
methods.description: Converts sockaddr to IP address string.

methods.name: set_receive_timeout
methods.description: Sets receive timeout on a socket.

methods.name: set_non_blocking
methods.description: Sets a socket to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: sock_type_to_str
methods.description: Converts socket type constant to string.

methods.name: sockaddr_storage_equal
methods.description: Checks equality of two sockaddr_storage objects.
